title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(藤田洋司研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Fujita Yoji)
keywords: Energy storage technology literacy 2.Energy storage device 3.Transient response and energy conversion 4.Reliability and safety evaluation 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students can discover new problems in the field of electricity and electronics and use their knowledge and skills to solve the problems. Set a theme for mastering batteries (power storage technology literacy), understand the social and technical background of electricity storage technology as an electrical expert, and learn how to solve problems and make presentations.
advice: [Outline of class] Conduct research activities alone or in groups.Have a weekly meeting.Submit weekly reports based on daily communication.The annual schedule is as follows. First semester: Create a research schedule for the first semester according to the project proposal. Learn the basics of research and investigate related literature.Submit weekly reports and learn the process of accelerating and modifying your plan.The results of the semester will be presented in June and August. Second semester: Create weekly reports and activate discussions.We hold briefings in October and December to improve presentation skills.The results will be compiled into a dissertation and presented at the public presentation judging committee. Summarize the handover materials for the next year's students. [Learning advice] Think and act on your own. Work on activities that give you a sense of achievement and solidarity when overcoming difficulties and questions. [Example of project theme] (1) Study on the effect of high voltage pulsed high electric field on batteries (2) Study on the effects of the equalization circuit and method for assembled batteries (3) Cell performance analysis and modeling of lead-acid batteries
books: Textbook: Not specified Reference book: Not specified Reserved book: Not specified
requiredKnowledge: Energy storage technology is the engineering of the boundary area. The following broad knowledge is required. ・ Social infrastructure related to environmental and energy issues ・ Power electronics related to charge / discharge control ・ Electrochemical energy conversion that handles the behavior of atoms ・ Evaluation of reliability required for practical use of equipment

activityGoals.body: Can clarify the purpose of research and draft a research plan.
Able to Communicate with research group members and faculty members to promote research.
Able to solve problems and issues in conducting research.
Research results can be summarized in a final report (project report).
Able to explain the contents of the research and effectively present the research results.
